description: File-plan mapping template. PRD F-018. NO RETENTION PERIOD IN THIS FILE IS AUTHORITATIVE. Every period, trigger and disposition action must be supplied and approved by Records Management and Legal before production record capture.

productionGate.rule: Deploy-DmsPurview.ps1 refuses Apply mode while any class has retentionAuthority or period set to REQUIRES_RECORDS_APPROVAL.
productionGate.rationale: PRD R-03: configuring labels before the file plan is approved causes over-retention, premature disposal or inaccessible content.

irreversibleControlsGate.declareAsRegulatoryRecord: PROHIBITED IN MVP. Requires separate written authorisation. PRD SEC-012, C-005, R-06.
irreversibleControlsGate.preservationLock: PROHIBITED IN MVP. Requires separate written authorisation.
irreversibleControlsGate.automaticPermanentDeletion: PROHIBITED IN MVP. Disposition review is the only approved path until Records Management authorises otherwise.
irreversibleControlsGate.enforcedBy: environments.*.allowIrreversiblePurviewChanges must be true AND an approved decision record must be referenced.

retentionClasses.notes: Candidate MVP pilot record class. PRD section 12.4 requires one operational-record class to validate the document-versus-record lifecycle.
Retaining superseded revisions is what allows an auditor to reconstruct what was effective at a past date. PRD NFR-012.

PRD NFR-012 requires evidence to survive for the longer of the document evidence period or the applicable audit policy. PRD R-12 warns that relying on standard audit retention or flow history will lose evidence. Must be set explicitly, not inherited.
Quality and change-control schedule. PRD DATA-003.
PRD NFR-016 and SEC-009 require personal data to be retained only as long as the approved evidence requirement. Storage limitation applies.

legalHoldInteraction.rule: A legal or eDiscovery hold overrides disposition. Items under hold are excluded from disposition processing and reported separately.

proofOfDisposition.rule: Disposition outcomes must be exportable as evidence. No user-interface delete substitutes for disposition.
